cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep Friday free in case I need moving help. A sensible plan includes contingency time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already promised Alex I'd paint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me a precise window, not 'sometime.' Could you answer your phone before you open the paint?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Have you actually found a flat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not yet. Please distinguish preparation from improvisation. I'd like to know whether I rank above a sealed tin.
